verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for an analytics product, whose SDKs could plausibly expose an opt-out. However, the evidence pack documents no opt-out control for telemetry or usage tracking. The GDPR deletion and retrieval APIs, EU data residency and Session Replay sampling are adjacent privacy and data controls, not an opt-out capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
